lighting_shading.note: Soft top-down lighting creates a clean, volumetric 3D feel.

value_contrast.note: Strong separation from background due to value and hue contrast.

color_palette.note: Warm beige and green palette with bright yellow badge accents.

composition_hierarchy.note: Central placement ensures the item is the sole focus.

shape_proportions.note: Chunky, rounded forms typical of modern stylized mobile games.

viewpoint_depth.note: Slight 3/4 angle provides depth without distorting the item.

edges_linework.note: Clean edges defined by shading rather than lines.

surface_finish.note: Smooth, matte surfaces with a clean digital render look.

pose_rhythm.note: Repetition of circular badges creates a rhythmic visual flow.
